summary: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd. (Nasdaq: YMAT) filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Staff Delisting Determination Letter on June 12, 2026, for non-compliance with the minimum bid price of $1.00 per share under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company failed to regain compliance within a 180-day period ending June 10, 2026, and is ineligible for a second extension. J-Star intends to request an oral hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel, which will stay any suspension or delisting pending the Panel's decision. The Class A ordinary shares will continue trading during the appeal process. The company will submit a compliance plan, but there is no assurance of a favorable outcome or a granted exception period. What to watch: the Panel's decision on continued listing and any stock consolidation or reverse split announced.
